class Window_MacAppWindow { constructor() { this.name = "MacAppWindow"; this.title = "macOS Style App"; this.width = 900; this.height = 600; } create() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Initialized context surface'); } destroy() { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Destroyed resources'); } setTitle(newTitle) { this.title = newTitle; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Title: ' + newTitle); } getTitle() { return this.title; } setFullscreen(flag) { console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Fullscreen: ' + flag); } setResizable(flag) { this.resizable = flag; console.log('[WINDOW ' + this.name + '] Resizable: ' + flag); } setAlwaysOnTop(flag) { this.alwaysOnTop = flag;
